preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract deployer/owner
Contract must not have been initialized yet (fresh deployment)

exploit_hint: The contract uses a constructor instead of an initializer function, making it vulnerable to front-running attacks. As the deployer, call the constructor with malicious parameters to set the token address to a controlled token, claimPeriod to 0, and subsequentClaim to a high value. This allows immediate and excessive token claims. Then add your address as a distribution wallet with a large balance and immediately call claim() to drain tokens.
